title: Behavioral, Leadership & Engineering Practices
intro: Behavioral interview questions are now equal-weighted with technical questions in every senior+ interview. This page covers the STAR method applied correctly, conflict resolution, agile/scrum scenarios, delivering under pressure, the failure-and-learning question (rehearsed but never canned), and career-growth narratives that do not sound rehearsed. For engineering-practice questions (code review, ADRs, technical debt, mentoring, technical leadership) see the Engineering Practices page — those are a separate, well-defined interview category.
